name: Campaign build sheet
summary: When an approved campaign brief is ready to become a setup specification, the campaign operator gets one build sheet: names, audiences, exclusions, destinations, budgets and measurement fields, with every unresolved setting and missing asset marked as a gap. Nothing is built or spent.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own published map of advertising and lead generation work, and its own method for turning an approved brief into a reviewable setup sheet.
